```lean
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Nat
open scoped BigOperators
namespace HaradaKernel
open Finset
def coeff (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k,
    if a * t = k then
      (((a : ℤ)^2 - 3 * (a : ℤ)) * ((2 * t - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2 * (a : ℤ))
    else 0) +
  (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 k,
    if a < b ∧ a * t + b * u = k then 2 * (a : ℤ) * ((b : ℤ) - 3) else 0)
end HaradaKernel
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.Enumerative.Partition.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Sort

namespace Harada

/-- The source's positive weakly decreasing row convention. -/
def Rows (n : ℕ) := {l : List ℕ // l.Pairwise (· ≥ ·) ∧ (∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a) ∧ l.sum = n}

def rows {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) : Rows n :=
  ⟨p.parts.sort (· ≥ ·), Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _,
    by intro a ha; exact p.parts_pos (by simpa only [Multiset.mem_sort] using ha),
    by simpa only [← Multiset.sum_coe, Multiset.sort_eq] using p.parts_sum⟩

def fromRows {n : ℕ} (l : Rows n) : Nat.Partition n :=
  ⟨l.1, by intro a ha; exact l.2.2.1 a (by simpa using ha), by simpa using l.2.2.2⟩

theorem fromRows_rows {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) : fromRows (rows p) = p := by
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  exact Multiset.sort_eq _ _

theorem rows_fromRows {n : ℕ} (l : Rows n) : rows (fromRows l) = l := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact List.mergeSort_eq_self _ l.2.1

def rowsEquiv (n : ℕ) : Nat.Partition n ≃ Rows n where
  toFun := rows
  invFun := fromRows
  left_inv := fromRows_rows
  right_inv := rows_fromRows

/-- Column j, indexed starting at one; also defined for missing columns. -/
def column {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (p.parts.filter (fun a => j ≤ a)).card

def multiplicity {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) : ℕ := p.parts.count j

def T {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) : ℕ :=
  (((rows p).1.zipIdx).map (fun ai => ai.2 * ai.1)).sum

/-- Exactly the three terms of Sugimoto's statistic, with the column tail zero. -/
def psi {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) : ℕ :=
  p.parts.card.choose 2 + T p +
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, column p (j+1) * column p (j+2)

noncomputable def p (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Fintype.card (Nat.Partition n)
noncomputable def D (n : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (n.choose 2 : ℤ) * p n - ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, (psi q : ℤ)

/-- Literal uniform target, a proposition only: no proof is claimed here. -/
def Target : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, 7 ≤ n → 0 < D n

theorem column_missing {n j : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (h : n < j) :
    column q j = 0 := by
  unfold column
  rw [Multiset.filter_eq_nil.mpr]
  · rfl
  · intro a ha
    have := q.le_of_mem_parts ha
    omega

def addOne {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) : Nat.Partition (n+1) where
  parts := 1 ::ₘ q.parts
  parts_pos := by intro a ha; simp only [Multiset.mem_cons] at ha; rcases ha with rfl | ha; omega; exact q.parts_pos ha
  parts_sum := by simp [q.parts_sum, Nat.add_comm]

theorem addOne_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@addOne n) := by
  intro a b h
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  have : 1 ::ₘ a.parts = 1 ::ₘ b.parts := congrArg Nat.Partition.parts h
  simpa only [Multiset.erase_cons_head] using congrArg (fun s : Multiset ℕ => s.erase 1) this

theorem p_step (n : ℕ) : p n ≤ p (n+1) :=
  Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (addOne_injective n)

theorem p_mono : Monotone p := monotone_nat_of_le_succ p_step

theorem p_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < p n := by
  let q : Nat.Partition n := ⟨Multiset.replicate n 1,
    by intro a ha; have : a = 1 := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp ha).2; omega,
    by simp⟩
  let : Nonempty (Nat.Partition n) := ⟨q⟩
  exact Fintype.card_pos

@[simp] theorem p_zero : p 0 = 1 := Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton _

@[simp] theorem p_one : p 1 = 1 := Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton _

#print axioms p_zero
#print axioms p_one
#print axioms p_pos
#print axioms rowsEquiv
#print axioms column_missing
#print axioms p_mono
end Harada
```

<!-- BEGIN FILE src/HaradaMultiplicity.lean 475792c2c1144b4ff929b2db4afb9903e133fbacab8be58a2b44f5fd0ce0c9e1 -->
```lean
import HaradaPartitions
import Mathlib.Data.Multiset.AddSub
namespace Harada

def eraseCopies {n a t : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n)
    (h : t ≤ q.parts.count a) : Nat.Partition (n-t*a) where
  parts := q.parts - Multiset.replicate t a
  parts_pos := by
    intro b hb
    exact q.parts_pos (Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) hb)
  parts_sum := by
    have he := congrArg Multiset.sum (tsub_add_cancel_of_le
      (Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp h))
    simp only [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, q.parts_sum] at he
    omega

def restoreCopies {n a t : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (h : t*a ≤ n)
    (q : Nat.Partition (n-t*a)) : {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} :=
  ⟨⟨q.parts + Multiset.replicate t a,
    by
      intro b hb
      rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hb with hb | hb
      · exact q.parts_pos hb
      · have := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hb).2; omega,
    by simp only [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, q.parts_sum]
       omega⟩,
    by simp only [Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate_self]; omega⟩

def multiplicityTailEquiv {n a t : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (h : t*a ≤ n) :
    {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} ≃ Nat.Partition (n-t*a) where
  toFun q := eraseCopies q.1 q.2
  invFun := restoreCopies ha h
  left_inv q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Nat.Partition.ext
    exact tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp q.2)
  right_inv q := by
    apply Nat.Partition.ext
    exact add_tsub_cancel_right _ _

theorem multiplicity_tail_card {n a t : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (h : t*a ≤ n) :
    Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} = p (n-t*a) :=
  Fintype.card_congr (multiplicityTailEquiv ha h)

#print axioms multiplicityTailEquiv
#print axioms multiplicity_tail_card
end Harada
```

<!-- BEGIN FILE src/HaradaLayerCake.lean 115484ef8eae927a2b56b78837d58fcc6d38764a699dcf428876a1aee86aabd4 -->
```lean
import HaradaMultiplicity
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem range_layer (N k : ℕ) (h : k ≤ N) :
    (∑ t ∈ range N, if t < k then 1 else 0) = k := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ N
    · simp [ih hk, show ¬ N < k by omega]
    · have he : k = N+1 := by omega
      subst k
      have : (∑ t ∈ range N, if t < N+1 then 1 else 0) = N := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ _t ∈ range N, 1 := by
            apply sum_congr rfl; intro t ht; simp [show t < N+1 by have := mem_range.mp ht; omega]
          _ = N := by simp
      simp [this]

theorem count_weight_le {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (a : ℕ) :
    q.parts.count a * a ≤ n := by
  have h := Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp (le_refl (q.parts.count a))
  have he := congrArg Multiset.sum (tsub_add_cancel_of_le h)
  simp only [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, q.parts_sum] at he
  omega

theorem count_le_n {n a : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    q.parts.count a ≤ n := by
  have h := count_weight_le q a
  exact (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ ha).trans h

theorem sum_multiplicity_layers (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a) =
      ∑ t ∈ range n, Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t+1 ≤ q.parts.count a} := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ t ∈ range n, if t < q.parts.count a then 1 else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro q _; exact (range_layer n _ (count_le_n ha q)).symm
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, if t < q.parts.count a then 1 else 0 := sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
      simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le]
      exact sum_boole _ _

#print axioms sum_multiplicity_layers
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaLayerCake
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
namespace Harada
open Finset
#eval Lean.versionString

def twoBlocks (a b t u : ℕ) : Multiset ℕ :=
  Multiset.replicate t a + Multiset.replicate u b

theorem twoBlocks_le {n a b t u : ℕ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (q : Nat.Partition n) (ht : t ≤ q.parts.count a) (hu : u ≤ q.parts.count b) :
    twoBlocks a b t u ≤ q.parts := by
  apply Multiset.le_iff_count.mpr
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = a
  · subst x; simpa [twoBlocks, Multiset.count_replicate, hab, Ne.symm hab] using ht
  · by_cases hy : x = b
    · subst x; simpa [twoBlocks, Multiset.count_replicate, hab, Ne.symm hab] using hu
    · simp [twoBlocks, Multiset.count_replicate, Ne.symm hx, Ne.symm hy]

theorem twoBlocks_weight_le {n a b t u : ℕ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (q : Nat.Partition n) (ht : t ≤ q.parts.count a) (hu : u ≤ q.parts.count b) :
    t*a+u*b ≤ n := by
  have he := congrArg Multiset.sum (tsub_add_cancel_of_le (twoBlocks_le hab q ht hu))
  simp only [Multiset.sum_add, twoBlocks, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul,
    q.parts_sum] at he
  omega

def eraseTwo {n a b t u : ℕ} (hab : a ≠ b) (q : Nat.Partition n)
    (ht : t ≤ q.parts.count a) (hu : u ≤ q.parts.count b) :
    Nat.Partition (n-(t*a+u*b)) where
  parts := q.parts - twoBlocks a b t u
  parts_pos := by
    intro x hx
    exact q.parts_pos (Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) hx)
  parts_sum := by
    have he := congrArg Multiset.sum (tsub_add_cancel_of_le (twoBlocks_le hab q ht hu))
    have hs : (twoBlocks a b t u).sum = t*a+u*b := by simp [twoBlocks]
    rw [Multiset.sum_add, hs, q.parts_sum] at he
    omega

def restoreTwo {n a b t u : ℕ} (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b)
    (h : t*a+u*b ≤ n) (q : Nat.Partition (n-(t*a+u*b))) :
    {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a ∧ u ≤ q.parts.count b} :=
  ⟨⟨q.parts + twoBlocks a b t u,
    by
      intro x hx
      rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hx with hx | hx
      · exact q.parts_pos hx
      · rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hx with hx | hx
        · have := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hx).2; omega
        · have := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hx).2; omega,
    by simp only [Multiset.sum_add, twoBlocks, Multiset.sum_replicate,
         smul_eq_mul, q.parts_sum]; omega⟩,
    by
      constructor
      · simp only [Multiset.count_add, twoBlocks, Multiset.count_replicate_self]
        omega
      · simp only [Multiset.count_add, twoBlocks, Multiset.count_replicate_self]
        omega⟩

def mixedTailEquiv {n a b t u : ℕ} (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (h : t*a+u*b ≤ n) :
    {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a ∧ u ≤ q.parts.count b} ≃
      Nat.Partition (n-(t*a+u*b)) where
  toFun q := eraseTwo hab q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2
  invFun := restoreTwo ha hb h
  left_inv q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Nat.Partition.ext
    exact tsub_add_cancel_of_le (twoBlocks_le hab q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
  right_inv q := by
    apply Nat.Partition.ext
    exact add_tsub_cancel_right _ _

theorem mixed_tail_card_all (n a b t u : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a ∧ u ≤ q.parts.count b} =
      if t*a+u*b ≤ n then p (n-(t*a+u*b)) else 0 := by
  classical
  split_ifs with h
  · exact Fintype.card_congr (mixedTailEquiv ha hb hab h)
  · have : IsEmpty {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a ∧ u ≤ q.parts.count b} :=
      ⟨fun q => h (twoBlocks_weight_le hab q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)⟩
    exact Fintype.card_of_isEmpty

#print axioms mixedTailEquiv
#print axioms mixed_tail_card_all
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaLayerCake
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem multiplicity_tail_card_all {n a t : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} =
      if t*a ≤ n then p (n-t*a) else 0 := by
  classical
  split_ifs with h
  · exact multiplicity_tail_card ha h
  · have : IsEmpty {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} := ⟨by
      intro q
      have hc := count_weight_le q.1 a
      have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right a q.2
      omega⟩
    exact Fintype.card_of_isEmpty

theorem total_multiplicity (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a) =
      ∑ t ∈ range n, if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0 := by
  rw [sum_multiplicity_layers n a ha]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
  exact multiplicity_tail_card_all ha

theorem parts_weight {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, q.parts.count a * a) = n := by
  have hp : q.parts.toFinset ⊆ Icc 1 n := by
    intro a ha
    have hm := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp ha
    exact mem_Icc.mpr ⟨q.parts_pos hm, q.le_of_mem_parts hm⟩
  simpa [smul_eq_mul, q.parts_sum] using
    (sum_multiset_count_of_subset q.parts (Icc 1 n) hp).symm

theorem marked_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    n * p n = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, a *
      ∑ t ∈ range n, if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0 := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, n := by simp [p, Nat.mul_comm]
    _ = ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, q.parts.count a * a := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro q _; exact (parts_weight q).symm
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a * a := sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      rw [← sum_mul, total_multiplicity n a (mem_Icc.mp ha).1]
      exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

#print axioms total_multiplicity
#print axioms marked_recurrence
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaJointTails
import HaradaMarked
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem weighted_multiplicity_layers (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ t ∈ range n,
      if t < q.parts.count a then f t else 0) =
    ∑ t ∈ range n, f t * (if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0) := by
  classical
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  have hc : (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, if t < q.parts.count a then 1 else 0) =
      Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t+1 ≤ q.parts.count a} := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le]
    exact sum_boole _ _
  rw [← multiplicity_tail_card_all ha, ← hc, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  split_ifs <;> simp

theorem total_mixed_multiplicity (n a b : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a * q.parts.count b) =
    ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ u ∈ range n,
      if (t+1)*a+(u+1)*b ≤ n then p (n-((t+1)*a+(u+1)*b)) else 0 := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ u ∈ range n,
        if t < q.parts.count a ∧ u < q.parts.count b then 1 else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro q _
      conv_lhs =>
        arg 1; rw [← range_layer n _ (count_le_n ha q)]
      conv_lhs =>
        arg 2; rw [← range_layer n _ (count_le_n hb q)]
      rw [sum_mul]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro u _
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ u ∈ range n,
        if t < q.parts.count a ∧ u < q.parts.count b then 1 else 0 := sum_comm
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ u ∈ range n, ∑ q : Nat.Partition n,
        if t < q.parts.count a ∧ u < q.parts.count b then 1 else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _; exact sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro u _
      rw [← mixed_tail_card_all n a b (t+1) (u+1) ha hb hab]
      simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le]
      exact sum_boole _ _

theorem range_weight_cut (N k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range N, if t < k then f t else 0) = ∑ t ∈ range k, f t := by
  classical
  have h : (range N).filter (fun t => t < k) = range k := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range]
    omega
  rw [← sum_filter, h]

theorem sum_odds_square (k : ℕ) : (∑ t ∈ range k, (2*t+1)) = k^2 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [sum_range_succ, ih]; ring

theorem sum_twice_factorial (k : ℕ) : (∑ t ∈ range k, 2*t) = k*(k-1) := by
  have h := sum_odds_square k
  simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  cases k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k => simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; nlinarith

theorem total_multiplicity_square (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, (q.parts.count a)^2) =
    ∑ t ∈ range n, (2*t+1) * (if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0) := by
  rw [← weighted_multiplicity_layers n a ha (fun t => 2*t+1)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  rw [range_weight_cut n _ (count_le_n ha q), sum_odds_square]

theorem total_multiplicity_factorial (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a * (q.parts.count a-1)) =
    ∑ t ∈ range n, (2*t) * (if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0) := by
  rw [← weighted_multiplicity_layers n a ha (fun t => 2*t)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  rw [range_weight_cut n _ (count_le_n ha q), sum_twice_factorial]

#print axioms total_mixed_multiplicity
#print axioms total_multiplicity_square
#print axioms total_multiplicity_factorial
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaMultiplicityMoments
namespace Harada
open Finset

noncomputable def countProductKernel (n a b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if a = b then
    ∑ t ∈ range n, (2*t+1) * (if (t+1)*a ≤ n then p (n-(t+1)*a) else 0)
  else ∑ t ∈ range n, ∑ u ∈ range n,
    if (t+1)*a+(u+1)*b ≤ n then p (n-((t+1)*a+(u+1)*b)) else 0

theorem total_count_product (n a b : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.count a * q.parts.count b) =
      countProductKernel n a b := by
  classical
  unfold countProductKernel
  split_ifs with h
  · subst b
    simpa only [pow_two] using total_multiplicity_square n a ha
  · exact total_mixed_multiplicity n a b ha hb h

theorem column_count_expansion {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) :
    column q j = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, if j ≤ a then q.parts.count a else 0 := by
  classical
  have h : ∀ a ∈ q.parts.filter (fun a => j ≤ a), a ∈ Icc 1 n := by
    intro a ha
    have hm := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp ha).1
    exact mem_Icc.mpr ⟨q.parts_pos hm, q.le_of_mem_parts hm⟩
  have hc := Multiset.sum_count_eq_card h
  simpa only [Multiset.count_filter, column] using hc.symm

noncomputable def columnProductKernel (n j k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
    if j ≤ a ∧ k ≤ b then countProductKernel n a b else 0

theorem total_column_product (n j k : ℕ) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, column q j * column q k) =
      columnProductKernel n j k := by
  classical
  have hp (q : Nat.Partition n) : column q j * column q k =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if j ≤ a ∧ k ≤ b then q.parts.count a * q.parts.count b else 0 := by
    rw [column_count_expansion q j, column_count_expansion q k, sum_mul]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [sum_comm]
  unfold columnProductKernel
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
  by_cases h : j ≤ a ∧ k ≤ b
  · simp only [h]
    exact total_count_product n a b (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (mem_Icc.mp hb).1
  · simp [h]

#print axioms total_count_product
#print axioms column_count_expansion
#print axioms total_column_product
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaMarked
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
namespace Harada
open Finset

/-- The finite weighted multiplicity layer sum; its triangular-number bridge is separate. -/
def sLayers {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) : ℕ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, if t ≤ q.parts.count a then t else 0

theorem sum_range_shift (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ t ∈ range n, f (t+1) = ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, f t := by
  apply sum_bij (fun t _ => t+1)
  · intro t ht; simp only [mem_range,mem_Icc] at *; omega
  · intro a _ b _ h; omega
  · intro t ht; refine ⟨t-1, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [mem_range,mem_Icc] at * <;> omega
  · intro _ _; rfl

theorem weighted_tail (n a t : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, if t ≤ q.parts.count a then t else 0) =
      t * (if t*a ≤ n then p (n-t*a) else 0) := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = t * (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, if t ≤ q.parts.count a then 1 else 0) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro q _; split_ifs <;> simp
    _ = t * Fintype.card {q : Nat.Partition n // t ≤ q.parts.count a} := by
      congr 1
      simp only [Fintype.card_subtype]
      exact sum_boole _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [multiplicity_tail_card_all ha]

theorem total_sLayers (n : ℕ) : (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, sLayers q) = n*p n := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
        t * (if t*a ≤ n then p (n-t*a) else 0) := by
      unfold sLayers
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
      exact weighted_tail n a t (mem_Icc.mp ha).1
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
        a * (if t*a ≤ n then p (n-t*a) else 0) := by
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
      simp only [Nat.mul_comm]
    _ = n*p n := by
      rw [marked_recurrence]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
      rw [mul_sum]
      exact (sum_range_shift n (fun t => a * (if t*a ≤ n then p (n-t*a) else 0))).symm

#print axioms weighted_tail
#print axioms total_sLayers
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaWeightedLayers
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem sum_successors_choose (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range k, (t+1)) = (k+1).choose 2 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ (k+1) 1, Nat.choose_one_right]
    change (k+1).choose 2 + (k+1) = (k+1) + (k+1).choose 2
    omega

theorem weighted_range_choose (N k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    (∑ t ∈ range N, if t < k then t+1 else 0) = (k+1).choose 2 := by
  have h : (∑ t ∈ range k, if t < k then t+1 else 0) =
      ∑ t ∈ range N, if t < k then t+1 else 0 := by
    apply sum_subset (range_mono hk)
    intro t _ ht
    simp only [mem_range] at ht
    simp [ht]
  rw [← h]
  calc
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range k, (t+1) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [ite_eq_left (mem_range.mp ht)]
    _ = _ := sum_successors_choose k

theorem weighted_Icc_choose (N k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    (∑ t ∈ Icc 1 N, if t ≤ k then t else 0) = (k+1).choose 2 := by
  rw [← sum_range_shift]
  simpa only [Nat.add_one_le_iff] using weighted_range_choose N k hk

/-- The literal finite triangular multiplicity statistic. -/
def sTri {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) : ℕ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (q.parts.count a + 1).choose 2

theorem sLayers_eq_sTri {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) : sLayers q = sTri q := by
  unfold sLayers sTri
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  exact weighted_Icc_choose n _ (count_le_n (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 q)

theorem total_sTri (n : ℕ) : (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, sTri q) = n*p n := by
  simpa only [sLayers_eq_sTri] using total_sLayers n

#print axioms sLayers_eq_sTri
#print axioms total_sTri
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaTriangular
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem twice_triangular (k : ℕ) : 2 * (k+1).choose 2 = k*(k+1) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ (k+1) 1, Nat.choose_one_right]
    change 2 * ((k+1) + (k+1).choose 2) = (k+1)*(k+1+1)
    nlinarith

theorem sum_counts {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, q.parts.count a) = q.parts.card := by
  apply Multiset.sum_count_eq_card
  intro a ha
  exact mem_Icc.mpr ⟨q.parts_pos ha, q.le_of_mem_parts ha⟩

theorem twice_sTri {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    2*sTri q = (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (q.parts.count a)^2) + q.parts.card := by
  rw [← sum_counts q]
  unfold sTri
  rw [mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [twice_triangular]
  ring

theorem total_multiplicity_squares (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (q.parts.count a)^2) +
      (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, q.parts.card) = 2*n*p n := by
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  simp_rw [← twice_sTri]
  rw [← mul_sum, total_sTri]
  ring

theorem column_step {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) :
    column q j = q.parts.count j + column q (j+1) := by
  have aux (s : Multiset ℕ) :
      (s.filter (fun a => j ≤ a)).card = s.count j +
        (s.filter (fun a => j+1 ≤ a)).card := by
    induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @cons a s ih =>
      by_cases he : a = j
      · subst a
        simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
      · by_cases hj : j ≤ a
        · have hj1 : j+1 ≤ a := by omega
          simp [hj, hj1, Ne.symm he, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
        · have hj1 : ¬ j+1 ≤ a := by omega
          simp [hj, hj1, Ne.symm he, ih]
  exact aux q.parts

theorem column_one {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) : column q 1 = q.parts.card := by
  unfold column
  rw [Multiset.filter_eq_self.mpr]
  intro a ha
  exact q.parts_pos ha

#print axioms twice_sTri
#print axioms total_multiplicity_squares
#print axioms column_step
#print axioms column_one
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaMoments
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem square_telescope (f m : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j < N, f j = m j + f (j+1)) :
    (∑ j ∈ range N, (m j)^2) + 2*(∑ j ∈ range N, f j*f (j+1)) + (f 0)^2 =
      2*(∑ j ∈ range N, (f j)^2) + (f N)^2 := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    have hi := ih (fun j hj => h j (by omega))
    have hs : (m N)^2 + 2*f N*f (N+1) = (f N)^2 + (f (N+1))^2 := by
      rw [h N (by omega)]
      ring
    simp only [sum_range_succ]
    nlinarith

theorem twice_choose_two (k : ℕ) : 2*k.choose 2 + k = k^2 := by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k =>
    have h := twice_triangular k
    change 2*(k+1).choose 2 + (k+1) = (k+1)^2
    nlinarith

theorem column_square_identity {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    sTri q + q.parts.card.choose 2 +
      (∑ j ∈ range n, column q (j+1)*column q (j+2)) =
      ∑ j ∈ range n, (column q (j+1))^2 := by
  have ht := square_telescope (fun j => column q (j+1))
    (fun j => q.parts.count (j+1)) n
    (fun j _ => column_step q (j+1))
  have hm : (∑ j ∈ range n, (q.parts.count (j+1))^2) =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (q.parts.count a)^2 :=
    sum_range_shift n (fun a => (q.parts.count a)^2)
  rw [hm, column_one q, column_missing q (by omega)] at ht
  have hs := twice_sTri q
  have hc := twice_choose_two q.parts.card
  nlinarith

/-- A source-faithful reduction: the remaining row/column pair count is explicit. -/
theorem psi_add_sTri {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n)
    (hrow : (∑ j ∈ range n, (column q (j+1))^2) = n + 2*T q) :
    psi q + sTri q = n + 3*T q := by
  have h := column_square_identity q
  unfold psi
  omega

#print axioms column_square_identity
#print axioms psi_add_sTri
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaColumnSquares
namespace Harada
open Finset

def rowW (l : List ℕ) : ℕ := (l.zipIdx.map (fun ai => ai.2*ai.1)).sum

theorem rowW_shift (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    ((l.zipIdx (i+1)).map (fun ai => ai.2*ai.1)).sum =
      ((l.zipIdx i).map (fun ai => ai.2*ai.1)).sum + l.sum := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.zipIdx_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [ih]
    ring

theorem rowW_cons (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : rowW (a::l) = rowW l + l.sum := by
  simpa [rowW] using rowW_shift l 0

def colL (l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((l : Multiset ℕ).filter (fun a => j ≤ a)).card

theorem colL_cons (a j : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    colL (a::l) j = colL l j + if j ≤ a then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j ≤ a <;> simp [colL, h]

theorem columns_sum (N : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (hb : ∀ a ∈ l, a ≤ N) :
    (∑ j ∈ range N, colL l (j+1)) = l.sum := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [colL]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp_rw [colL_cons]
    rw [sum_add_distrib, ih (by intro b h; exact hb b (by simp [h]))]
    have h := range_layer N a (hb a (by simp))
    simp only [Nat.add_one_le_iff] at *
    rw [h]
    simp [Nat.add_comm]


theorem colL_zero (l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) (h : ∀ a ∈ l, a < j) : colL l j = 0 := by
  unfold colL
  rw [Multiset.filter_eq_nil.mpr]
  · rfl
  · intro a ha
    have := h a (by simpa using ha)
    omega

theorem columns_squares (N : ℕ) (l : List ℕ)
    (hs : l.Pairwise (· ≥ ·)) (hb : ∀ a ∈ l, a ≤ N) :
    (∑ j ∈ range N, (colL l (j+1))^2) = l.sum + 2*rowW l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [colL, rowW]
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hs
    have hbl : ∀ b ∈ l, b ≤ N := by intro b h; exact hb b (by simp [h])
    have hi := ih hs.2 hbl
    have ht : ∀ j ∈ range N, (colL (a::l) (j+1))^2 =
        (colL l (j+1))^2 + 2*colL l (j+1) + (if j<a then 1 else 0) := by
      intro j _
      rw [colL_cons]
      by_cases hj : j<a
      · simp only [Nat.add_one_le_iff, hj, ite_true]
        ring
      · have hz : colL l (j+1) = 0 := colL_zero l _ (by
          intro b h; have := hs.1 b h; omega)
        simp [Nat.add_one_le_iff, hj, hz]
    rw [sum_congr rfl ht]
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, columns_sum N l hbl,
      range_layer N a (hb a (by simp)), hi, rowW_cons]
    simp only [List.sum_cons]
    ring

#print axioms columns_squares
#print axioms rowW_cons
#print axioms columns_sum
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaRows
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem colL_rows {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) :
    colL (rows q).1 j = column q j := by
  unfold colL column rows
  rw [Multiset.sort_eq]

theorem source_row_square {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, (column q (j+1))^2) = n + 2*T q := by
  have hb : ∀ a ∈ (rows q).1, a ≤ n := by
    intro a ha
    apply q.le_of_mem_parts
    simpa only [rows, Multiset.mem_sort] using ha
  have h := columns_squares n (rows q).1 (rows q).2.1 hb
  simpa only [colL_rows, (rows q).2.2.2, rowW, T] using h

/-- Literal pointwise source identity, with no truncated subtraction. -/
theorem source_psi_add_s {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    psi q + (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (q.parts.count a+1).choose 2) = n + 3*T q :=
  psi_add_sTri q (source_row_square q)

/-- The weighted sum uses actual sorted-row T and actual source psi. -/
theorem source_total_psi (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, psi q) = 3*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) := by
  have h : (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, psi q) + (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, sTri q) =
      (∑ q : Nat.Partition n, n) + 3*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro q _
    exact source_psi_add_s q
  rw [total_sTri] at h
  have hc : (∑ _q : Nat.Partition n, n) = n*p n := by
    simp [p, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hc] at h
  omega

#print axioms source_row_square
#print axioms source_psi_add_s
#print axioms source_total_psi
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaLiteralWeighted
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem source_D_reduction (n : ℕ) :
    D n = (n.choose 2 : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ) -
      3*((∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  unfold D
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, source_total_psi, Nat.cast_mul]
  rfl

theorem source_D_pos_iff (n : ℕ) :
    0 < D n ↔ 3*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) < n.choose 2 * p n := by
  rw [source_D_reduction, sub_pos]
  exact_mod_cast (Iff.rfl :
    3*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) < n.choose 2 * p n ↔
      3*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) < n.choose 2 * p n)

#print axioms source_D_reduction
#print axioms source_D_pos_iff
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaColumnMoments
import HaradaDReduction
namespace Harada
open Finset

noncomputable def squareMomentCoefficient (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j ∈ range n, columnProductKernel n (j+1) (j+1)

theorem source_T_moment_identity (n : ℕ) :
    squareMomentCoefficient n = n*p n + 2*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q) := by
  classical
  unfold squareMomentCoefficient
  simp_rw [← total_column_product, ← pow_two]
  rw [sum_comm]
  simp_rw [source_row_square]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]
  simp [p, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem source_psi_moment_identity (n : ℕ) :
    2*(∑ q : Nat.Partition n, psi q) + 3*n*p n =
      3*squareMomentCoefficient n := by
  rw [source_total_psi, source_T_moment_identity]
  ring

/-- Exact finite coefficient identity for unchanged literal source D. -/
theorem source_D_moment_identity (n : ℕ) :
    2*D n + 3*(squareMomentCoefficient n : ℤ) =
      (2*(n.choose 2 : ℤ)+3*(n : ℤ))*(p n : ℤ) := by
  have h : (squareMomentCoefficient n : ℤ) =
      (n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ)+2*((∑ q : Nat.Partition n, T q : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast source_T_moment_identity n
  rw [source_D_reduction, h]
  ring

theorem source_D_moment_pos_iff (n : ℕ) :
    0 < D n ↔ 3*squareMomentCoefficient n < (2*n.choose 2+3*n)*p n := by
  have h := source_D_moment_identity n
  have hc : (3*squareMomentCoefficient n : ℤ) <
      (2*(n.choose 2 : ℤ)+3*(n : ℤ))*(p n : ℤ) ↔
      3*squareMomentCoefficient n < (2*n.choose 2+3*n)*p n := by
    exact_mod_cast (Iff.rfl : 3*squareMomentCoefficient n < (2*n.choose 2+3*n)*p n ↔
      3*squareMomentCoefficient n < (2*n.choose 2+3*n)*p n)
  rw [← hc]
  omega

#print axioms source_T_moment_identity
#print axioms source_psi_moment_identity
#print axioms source_D_moment_identity
#print axioms source_D_moment_pos_iff
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaMomentCoefficient
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem countProductKernel_symm (n a b : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b) :
    countProductKernel n a b = countProductKernel n b a := by
  rw [← total_count_product n a b ha hb, ← total_count_product n b a hb ha]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

theorem range_min_weight (n a b w : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ n) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, if j+1 ≤ a ∧ j+1 ≤ b then w else 0) = min a b * w := by
  have h : (∑ j ∈ range n, if j+1 ≤ a ∧ j+1 ≤ b then w else 0) =
      (∑ j ∈ range n, if j < min a b then 1 else 0) * w := by
    rw [sum_mul]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : j < min a b
    · have hj' : j+1 ≤ a ∧ j+1 ≤ b := by omega
      simp [hj, hj']
    · have hj' : ¬ (j+1 ≤ a ∧ j+1 ≤ b) := by omega
      simp [hj, hj']
  rw [h, range_layer n (min a b) ((min_le_left _ _).trans ha)]

theorem squareMoment_eq_min (n : ℕ) :
    squareMomentCoefficient n =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, min a b * countProductKernel n a b := by
  classical
  unfold squareMomentCoefficient columnProductKernel
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  exact range_min_weight n a b _ (mem_Icc.mp ha).2

theorem parts_weight_square {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
      a*b*(q.parts.count a * q.parts.count b)) = n^2 := by
  calc
    _ = (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, q.parts.count a*a) *
        (∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, q.parts.count b*b) := by
      rw [sum_mul]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    _ = n^2 := by rw [parts_weight]; ring


theorem total_weight_square (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, a*b*countProductKernel n a b) = n^2*p n := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, a*b*(q.parts.count a*q.parts.count b) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro b hb
      rw [← total_count_product n a b (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (mem_Icc.mp hb).1, mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ q : Nat.Partition n, ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        a*b*(q.parts.count a*q.parts.count b) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        arg 2
        ext a
        rw [sum_comm]
      rw [sum_comm]
    _ = n^2*p n := by simp_rw [parts_weight_square]; simp [p, Nat.mul_comm]

#print axioms countProductKernel_symm
#print axioms squareMoment_eq_min
#print axioms total_weight_square
end Harada
```

<!-- BEGIN FILE src/HaradaSymmetricMoments.lean 698eec172e3950c3b6a944785567c11aa9054061d3abb4ff5973dba8c924a920 -->
```lean
import HaradaMinMoments
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem symmetric_sum_split (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∀ b ∈ Icc 1 n, f a b = f b a) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, f a b) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, f a a) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, if a<b then f a b else 0) := by
  classical
  have hp (a b : ℕ) : f a b = (if a=b then f a b else 0) +
      (if a<b then f a b else 0) + (if b<a then f a b else 0) := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h <;> simp [Nat.ne_of_lt,
      Nat.ne_of_gt, Nat.not_lt_of_ge, le_of_lt, *]
  have hl : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, if b<a then f a b else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, if a<b then f a b else 0 := by
    rw [sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
    rw [hs b hb a ha]
  calc
    _ = (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, f a a) +
        (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, if a<b then f a b else 0) +
        (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, if b<a then f a b else 0) := by
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext a; arg 2; ext b; rw [hp a b]
      simp only [sum_add_distrib]
      congr 2
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      simp [ha]
    _ = _ := by rw [hl]; omega

theorem squareMoment_split (n : ℕ) :
    squareMomentCoefficient n =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, a*countProductKernel n a a) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then a*countProductKernel n a b else 0) := by
  rw [squareMoment_eq_min, symmetric_sum_split]
  · simp only [min_self]
    congr 2
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
    by_cases h : a<b
    · simp [h, min_eq_left (le_of_lt h)]
    · simp [h]
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [min_comm, countProductKernel_symm n a b (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (mem_Icc.mp hb).1]


theorem weight_square_split (n : ℕ) :
    n^2*p n = (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, a^2*countProductKernel n a a) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then a*b*countProductKernel n a b else 0) := by
  rw [← total_weight_square, symmetric_sum_split]
  · simp only [pow_two]
  · intro a ha b hb
    rw [countProductKernel_symm n a b (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (mem_Icc.mp hb).1]
    ring

#print axioms symmetric_sum_split
#print axioms squareMoment_split
#print axioms weight_square_split
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaSymmetricMoments
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem source_D_square_identity (n : ℕ) :
    2*D n + 3*(squareMomentCoefficient n : ℤ) =
      ((n : ℤ)^2 + 2*n)*(p n : ℤ) := by
  have h := source_D_moment_identity n
  have hc : 2*(n.choose 2 : ℤ)+(n : ℤ) = (n : ℤ)^2 := by
    exact_mod_cast twice_choose_two n
  nlinarith

theorem source_D_signed_moments (n : ℕ) :
    2*D n =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ((a : ℤ)^2-3*a)*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*((b : ℤ)-3)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) +
      2*(n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ) := by
  classical
  have hc := source_D_square_identity n
  have hs := squareMoment_split n
  have hw := weight_square_split n
  have hs' : (squareMomentCoefficient n : ℤ) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (a : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) := by
    exact_mod_cast hs
  have hw' : (n : ℤ)^2*(p n : ℤ) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (a : ℤ)^2*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*(b : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) := by
    exact_mod_cast hw
  have he : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ((a : ℤ)^2-3*a)*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (a : ℤ)^2*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) -
      3*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, (a : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) := by
    simp_rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum]
  have hf : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*((b : ℤ)-3)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*(b : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) -
      3*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0) := by
    rw [mul_sum, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    rw [mul_sum, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [he, hf]
  nlinarith

#print axioms source_D_square_identity
#print axioms source_D_signed_moments
end Harada
```

<!-- BEGIN FILE src/HaradaFiniteConvolution.lean 18c491a69cc1753357d9e14bf96ed03b30f5c6e6b3e5f92196e8df0abc706b5e -->
```lean
import HaradaSignedMoments
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem finite_fiber_convolution {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (w : α → ℕ) (c : α → ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0<w x) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, if w x ≤ n then c x*(p (n-w x) : ℤ) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, (∑ x ∈ s, if w x=k then c x else 0)*(p (n-k) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  have he (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) :
      (if w x ≤ n then c x*(p (n-w x) : ℤ) else 0) =
        ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, if w x=k then c x*(p (n-k) : ℤ) else 0 := by
    by_cases h : w x ≤ n
    · have hm : w x ∈ Icc 1 n := mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hw x hx, h⟩
      simp [h, hm]
    · have hm : w x ∉ Icc 1 n := by simp [h]
      simp [h, hm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if w x=k then c x*(p (n-k) : ℤ) else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro x hx; exact he x hx
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ x ∈ s,
        if w x=k then c x*(p (n-k) : ℤ) else 0 := sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro k _
      rw [sum_mul]
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro x _
      split_ifs <;> simp

noncomputable def singleWeightFiber (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, if a*t=k then f a t else 0

theorem singleWeightFiber_cutoff (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, if a*t=k then f a t else 0) =
      singleWeightFiber k f := by
  classical
  have hs : Icc 1 k ⊆ Icc 1 n := by intro a ha; simp only [mem_Icc] at *; omega
  have hp (a t : ℕ) (ha : 1≤a) (ht : 1≤t) (he : a*t=k) : a≤k ∧ t≤k := by
    constructor
    · calc a ≤ a*t := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right a ht
           _ = k := he
    · calc t ≤ a*t := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left t ha
           _ = k := he
  have hi (a : ℕ) (ha : 1≤a) :
      (∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, if a*t=k then f a t else 0) =
        ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, if a*t=k then f a t else 0 := by
    symm
    apply sum_subset hs
    intro t ht htk
    have hn : a*t ≠ k := by
      intro he
      exact htk (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(mem_Icc.mp ht).1,
        (hp a t ha (mem_Icc.mp ht).1 he).2⟩)
    simp [hn]
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, if a*t=k then f a t else 0 := by
      symm
      apply sum_subset hs
      intro a ha hak
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro t ht
      have hn : a*t ≠ k := by
        intro he
        exact hak (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(mem_Icc.mp ha).1,
          (hp a t (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (mem_Icc.mp ht).1 he).1⟩)
      simp [hn]
    _ = _ := by
      unfold singleWeightFiber
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      exact hi a (mem_Icc.mp ha).1

theorem single_weight_convolution (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
      if a*t≤n then f a t*(p (n-a*t) : ℤ) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, singleWeightFiber k f*(p (n-k) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  have h := finite_fiber_convolution ((Icc 1 n) ×ˢ (Icc 1 n))
    (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1*x.2) (fun x => f x.1 x.2) n (by
      intro x hx
      have hx' := mem_product.mp hx
      exact Nat.mul_pos (mem_Icc.mp hx'.1).1 (mem_Icc.mp hx'.2).1)
  simp only [sum_product] at h
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro k hk
  rw [singleWeightFiber_cutoff n k (mem_Icc.mp hk).2]

#print axioms single_weight_convolution
#print axioms finite_fiber_convolution
#print axioms singleWeightFiber_cutoff
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaFiniteConvolution
namespace Harada
open Finset

def twoSizeDomain (n : ℕ) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
  ((Icc 1 n) ×ˢ (Icc 1 n)) ×ˢ ((Icc 1 n) ×ˢ (Icc 1 n))

def twoSizeWeight (x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) : ℕ := x.1.1*x.1.2+x.2.1*x.2.2

theorem twoSizeDomain_mono {k n : ℕ} (hkn : k≤n) :
    twoSizeDomain k ⊆ twoSizeDomain n := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [twoSizeDomain, mem_product, mem_Icc] at *
  omega

theorem twoSizeWeight_pos {n : ℕ} {x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hx : x ∈ twoSizeDomain n) : 0<twoSizeWeight x := by
  simp only [twoSizeDomain, mem_product, mem_Icc] at hx
  have h := Nat.mul_pos hx.1.1.1 hx.1.2.1
  unfold twoSizeWeight
  omega

theorem twoSizeWeight_cutoff {n k : ℕ} {x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hx : x ∈ twoSizeDomain n) (he : twoSizeWeight x=k) : x ∈ twoSizeDomain k := by
  simp only [twoSizeDomain, mem_product, mem_Icc] at *
  have ha := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right x.1.1 hx.1.2.1
  have ht := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left x.1.2 hx.1.1.1
  have hb := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right x.2.1 hx.2.2.1
  have hu := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left x.2.2 hx.2.1.1
  unfold twoSizeWeight at he
  omega

noncomputable def doubleWeightFiber (k : ℕ) (f : ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℤ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ x ∈ twoSizeDomain k, if twoSizeWeight x=k then f x else 0

theorem doubleWeightFiber_cutoff (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k≤n)
    (f : ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℤ) :
    (∑ x ∈ twoSizeDomain n, if twoSizeWeight x=k then f x else 0) =
      doubleWeightFiber k f := by
  classical
  unfold doubleWeightFiber
  symm
  apply sum_subset (twoSizeDomain_mono hkn)
  intro x hx hxk
  have h : twoSizeWeight x ≠ k := by
    intro he
    exact hxk (twoSizeWeight_cutoff hx he)
  simp [h]


theorem double_weight_convolution (n : ℕ)
    (f : ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℤ) :
    (∑ x ∈ twoSizeDomain n,
      if twoSizeWeight x≤n then f x*(p (n-twoSizeWeight x) : ℤ) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, doubleWeightFiber k f*(p (n-k) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  rw [finite_fiber_convolution (twoSizeDomain n) twoSizeWeight f n
    (fun _ hx => twoSizeWeight_pos hx)]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro k hk
  rw [doubleWeightFiber_cutoff n k (mem_Icc.mp hk).2]

#print axioms twoSizeWeight_pos
#print axioms twoSizeWeight_cutoff
#print axioms doubleWeightFiber_cutoff
#print axioms double_weight_convolution
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaDoubleConvolution
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem countProduct_diagonal_Icc (n a : ℕ) :
    countProductKernel n a a = ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
      (2*t-1)*(if t*a≤n then p (n-t*a) else 0) := by
  unfold countProductKernel
  simp only [ite_true]
  rw [← sum_range_shift n (fun t => (2*t-1)*(if t*a≤n then p (n-t*a) else 0))]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
  have h : 2*(t+1)-1=2*t+1 := by omega
  rw [h]

theorem countProduct_mixed_Icc (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a≠b) :
    countProductKernel n a b = ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 n,
      if t*a+u*b≤n then p (n-(t*a+u*b)) else 0 := by
  unfold countProductKernel
  simp only [hab, ↓reduceIte]
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 2; ext t
    rw [sum_range_shift n (fun u => if (t+1)*a+u*b≤n then p (n-((t+1)*a+u*b)) else 0)]
  exact sum_range_shift n (fun t => ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 n,
    if t*a+u*b≤n then p (n-(t*a+u*b)) else 0)

theorem marked_recurrence_Icc (n : ℕ) :
    n*p n = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
      a*(if t*a≤n then p (n-t*a) else 0) := by
  rw [marked_recurrence]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
  rw [sum_range_shift n (fun t => if t*a≤n then p (n-t*a) else 0), mul_sum]

#print axioms countProduct_diagonal_Icc
#print axioms countProduct_mixed_Icc
#print axioms marked_recurrence_Icc
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaShiftedTails
namespace Harada
open Finset

noncomputable def guardedPartition (n k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if k≤n then (p (n-k) : ℤ) else 0

theorem countProduct_diagonal_int (n a : ℕ) :
    (countProductKernel n a a : ℤ) =
      ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, ((2*t-1 : ℕ) : ℤ)*guardedPartition n (a*t) := by
  rw [countProduct_diagonal_Icc]
  simp only [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_zero,
    guardedPartition, Nat.mul_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
  ring

theorem countProduct_mixed_int (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a≠b) :
    (countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) =
      ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 n, guardedPartition n (a*t+b*u) := by
  rw [countProduct_mixed_Icc n a b hab]
  simp only [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_zero, guardedPartition, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem marked_recurrence_int (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ) =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, (a : ℤ)*guardedPartition n (a*t) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : ℕ => (z : ℤ)) (marked_recurrence_Icc n)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_zero,
    guardedPartition, Nat.mul_comm] using h

theorem source_D_tail_identity (n : ℕ) :
    2*D n =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
        (((a : ℤ)^2-3*a)*((2*t-1 : ℕ) : ℤ)+2*a)*guardedPartition n (a*t)) +
      2*(∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*((b : ℤ)-3)*guardedPartition n (a*t+b*u) else 0) := by
  classical
  have hd := source_D_signed_moments n
  have hs : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n,
        (((a : ℤ)^2-3*a)*((2*t-1 : ℕ) : ℤ)+2*a)*guardedPartition n (a*t)) =
      (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ((a : ℤ)^2-3*a)*(countProductKernel n a a : ℤ)) +
      2*(n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ) := by
    rw [show 2*(n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ) = 2*((n : ℤ)*(p n : ℤ)) by ring,
      marked_recurrence_int]
    simp_rw [countProduct_diagonal_int, mul_sum, add_mul, mul_assoc,
      sum_add_distrib]

  have hm : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*((b : ℤ)-3)*guardedPartition n (a*t+b*u) else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 n,
        if a<b then (a : ℤ)*((b : ℤ)-3)*(countProductKernel n a b : ℤ) else 0 := by
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
    by_cases h : a<b
    · rw [countProduct_mixed_int n a b (Nat.ne_of_lt h)]
      simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, mul_sum]
    · simp [h]
  rw [hs, hm]
  linarith

#print axioms countProduct_diagonal_int
#print axioms countProduct_mixed_int
#print axioms marked_recurrence_int
#print axioms source_D_tail_identity
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaExplicitDTails
import HaradaDoubleConvolution
import HaradaKernelCoefficient
namespace Harada
open Finset

def singleCoefficient (a t : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ((a : ℤ)^2 - 3*a)*((2*t-1 : ℕ) : ℤ)+2*a

def doubleCoefficient (x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) : ℤ :=
  if x.1.1 < x.2.1 then 2*(x.1.1 : ℤ)*((x.2.1 : ℤ)-3) else 0

theorem coeff_eq_fibers (k : ℕ) : HaradaKernel.coeff k =
    singleWeightFiber k singleCoefficient + doubleWeightFiber k doubleCoefficient := by
  classical
  simp only [HaradaKernel.coeff, singleWeightFiber, singleCoefficient,
    doubleWeightFiber, twoSizeDomain, sum_product, twoSizeWeight, doubleCoefficient]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
  apply sum_congr rfl; intro u _
  by_cases h : a < b <;> by_cases hw : a*t+b*u=k <;> simp [h, hw]

theorem source_D_convolution (n : ℕ) :
    2*D n = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, HaradaKernel.coeff k*(p (n-k) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [coeff_eq_fibers, add_mul]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, ← single_weight_convolution, ← double_weight_convolution,
    source_D_tail_identity]
  congr 1
  · simp only [singleCoefficient, guardedPartition, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  · simp only [twoSizeDomain, sum_product, twoSizeWeight, doubleCoefficient]
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    rw [sum_comm (s := Icc 1 n) (t := Icc 1 n)]
    simp only [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro t _
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b _
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro u _
    by_cases h : a < b <;> by_cases hw : a*t+b*u≤n <;>
      simp [h, hw, guardedPartition]
    all_goals ring

#print axioms coeff_eq_fibers
#print axioms source_D_convolution
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaPartitions
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum

namespace Harada

def B (n k : ℕ) := {q : Nat.Partition n // ∀ a ∈ q.parts, a ≤ k}
noncomputable instance (n k : ℕ) : Fintype (B n k) := by classical exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype {q : Nat.Partition n // _})
noncomputable def b (n k : ℕ) := Fintype.card (B n k)

noncomputable def hasEquiv {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hn : k ≤ n) :
    {q : B n k // k ∈ q.1.parts} ≃ B (n-k) k where
  toFun q := ⟨(Nat.Partition.partitionWithPartEquiv hk hn) ⟨q.1.1, q.2⟩,
    by intro a ha; exact q.1.2 a (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase ha)⟩
  invFun q := ⟨⟨(Nat.Partition.partitionWithPartEquiv hk hn).symm q.1 |>.1,
    by intro a ha; simp only [Nat.Partition.partitionWithPartEquiv_symm_apply_parts,
      Multiset.mem_cons] at ha; rcases ha with rfl | ha; exact le_rfl; exact q.2 a ha⟩,
    by simp⟩
  left_inv q := by
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (Nat.Partition.ext (Multiset.cons_erase q.2)))
  right_inv q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (Nat.Partition.partitionWithPartEquiv hk hn).right_inv q.1

noncomputable def notEquiv (n k : ℕ) :
    {q : B n k // ¬ k ∈ q.1.parts} ≃ B n (k-1) where
  toFun q := ⟨q.1.1, by
    intro a ha
    have hb := q.1.2 a ha
    have hne : a ≠ k := fun h => q.2 (h ▸ ha)
    omega⟩
  invFun q := ⟨⟨q.1, by intro a ha; have := q.2 a ha; omega⟩,
    by intro h; have := q.2 k h; have := q.1.parts_pos h; omega⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem b_recurrence {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hn : k ≤ n) :
    b n k = b (n-k) k + b n (k-1) := by
  classical
  let e := (Equiv.sumCompl (fun q : B n k => k ∈ q.1.parts)).symm
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (e.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (hasEquiv hk hn) (notEquiv n k)))
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sum, b] using h

noncomputable def boundedAll (n k : ℕ) (h : n ≤ k) : B n k ≃ Nat.Partition n where
  toFun := Subtype.val
  invFun q := ⟨q, by intro a ha; exact (q.le_of_mem_parts ha).trans h⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem b_eq_p {n k : ℕ} (h : n ≤ k) : b n k = p n :=
  Fintype.card_congr (boundedAll n k h)

theorem b_zero (k : ℕ) : b 0 k = 1 := by
  classical
  let e : B 0 k ≃ Nat.Partition 0 :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      invFun := fun q => ⟨q, by simp⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact (Fintype.card_congr e).trans (p_zero)

theorem b_no_parts {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : b n 0 = 0 := by
  classical
  have : IsEmpty (B n 0) := ⟨by
    intro q
    have hz : q.1.parts = 0 := Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem (by
      intro a ha
      have := q.2 a ha
      have := q.1.parts_pos ha
      omega)
    have hs := q.1.parts_sum
    simp only [hz, Multiset.sum_zero] at hs
    omega⟩
  exact Fintype.card_eq_zero

noncomputable def lowerBoundEquiv {n k : ℕ} (h : n < k) : B n k ≃ B n (k-1) where
  toFun q := ⟨q.1, by intro a ha; have := q.1.le_of_mem_parts ha; omega⟩
  invFun q := ⟨q.1, by intro a ha; have := q.2 a ha; omega⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem b_above {n k : ℕ} (h : n < k) : b n k = b n (k-1) :=
  Fintype.card_congr (lowerBoundEquiv h)

/-- An exact integer DP, not an assumed recurrence for an abstract sequence. -/
def dp : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | _n+1, 0 => 0
  | n+1, k+1 => if k+1 ≤ n+1 then dp (n+1-(k+1)) (k+1) + dp (n+1) k else dp (n+1) k
termination_by n k => n+k

theorem b_eq_dp (n k : ℕ) : b n k = dp n k := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa only [dp] using b_zero k
  | succ n =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simpa only [dp] using b_no_parts (n := n+1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    | succ k =>
      rw [dp]
      split
      next h =>
        rw [b_recurrence (by omega) h, Nat.add_sub_cancel, b_eq_dp (n+1-(k+1)) (k+1), b_eq_dp (n+1) k]
      next h =>
        rw [b_above (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel, b_eq_dp (n+1) k]
termination_by n+k

theorem p_eq_dp (n : ℕ) : p n = dp n n :=
  (b_eq_p (le_refl n)).symm.trans (b_eq_dp n n)

#print axioms b_zero
#print axioms b_no_parts
#print axioms b_above
#print axioms b_eq_dp
#print axioms p_eq_dp
#print axioms hasEquiv
#print axioms notEquiv
#print axioms b_recurrence
#print axioms b_eq_p
end Harada
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Piecewise
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import HaradaKernelCoefficient
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
open scoped BigOperators
namespace HaradaKernel
open Finset
private theorem fiber_lower (k a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℤ)
    (hB : B ≤ 0) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc 1 k, a*t=k → B ≤ f t) :
    B ≤ ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, if a*t=k then f t else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ t ∈ Icc 1 k, a*t=k
  · obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := h
    rw [sum_eq_single t]
    · simpa [he] using hf t ht he
    · intro u hu hut
      have : a*u ≠ k := by intro he'; apply hut; nlinarith
      simp [this]
    · intro hn; exact (hn ht).elim
  · have hz : ∀ t ∈ Icc 1 k, a*t ≠ k := by simpa only [not_exists, not_and] using h
    apply le_trans hB
    apply sum_nonneg
    intro t ht
    simp [hz t ht]

def single (k a : ℕ) : ℤ := ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k,
  if a*t=k then (((a:ℤ)^2-3*(a:ℤ))*((2*t-1:ℕ):ℤ)+2*(a:ℤ)) else 0

theorem single_nonneg (k a : ℕ) (ha : 3 ≤ a) : 0 ≤ single k a := by
  apply sum_nonneg
  intro t ht
  split_ifs
  · have : (0:ℤ) ≤ (a:ℤ)^2-3*(a:ℤ) := by
      have hcast : (3:ℤ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast ha
      nlinarith
    positivity
  · rfl

theorem single_one_lower (k : ℕ) : -4*(k:ℤ) ≤ single k 1 := by
  apply fiber_lower k 1 (by omega)
  · omega
  · intro t ht he
    have : t=k := by omega
    subst t
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ k := (mem_Icc.mp ht).1
    have hc : ((2*k-1:ℕ):ℤ)=2*(k:ℤ)-1 := by omega
    simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_pow, hc]
    omega

theorem single_two_lower (k : ℕ) : -2*(k:ℤ) ≤ single k 2 := by
  apply fiber_lower k 2 (by omega)
  · omega
  · intro t ht he
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (mem_Icc.mp ht).1
    have hc : ((2*t-1:ℕ):ℤ)=2*(t:ℤ)-1 := by omega
    have he' : 2*(t:ℤ)=(k:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast he
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, hc]
    omega

theorem single_self (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : single k k = (k:ℤ)^2-(k:ℤ) := by
  unfold single
  rw [sum_eq_single 1]
  · simp; ring
  · intro t ht ht1
    have : k*t ≠ k := by intro h; apply ht1; nlinarith
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact (h (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega,hk⟩)).elim

theorem single_sum_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (k:ℤ)^2-7*(k:ℤ) ≤ ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, single k a := by
  classical
  let G := fun a => single k a + (if a=1 then 4*(k:ℤ) else 0) +
    (if a=2 then 2*(k:ℤ) else 0)
  have hG : ∀ a ∈ Icc 1 k, 0 ≤ G a := by
    intro a ha
    by_cases h1 : a=1
    · subst a; simp only [G, ite_true, OfNat.one_ne_ofNat, ite_false, add_zero]
      linarith [single_one_lower k]
    by_cases h2 : a=2
    · subst a; simp only [G, ite_true, h1, ite_false, add_zero]
      linarith [single_two_lower k]
    simpa [G,h1,h2] using single_nonneg k a (by have := (mem_Icc.mp ha).1; omega)
  have h := single_le_sum hG (mem_Icc.mpr (show 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ k by omega))
  have h1 : k ≠ 1 := by omega
  have h2 : k ≠ 2 := by omega
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, G a) = (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, single k a)+6*(k:ℤ) := by
    simp [G, sum_add_distrib, mem_Icc, show 1 ≤ k by omega, show 2 ≤ k by omega]
    ring
  rw [hsum] at h
  simp only [G,h1,h2,ite_false,add_zero,single_self k (by omega)] at h
  linarith


def cell (k a t b : ℕ) : ℤ := ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 k,
  if a < b ∧ a*t+b*u=k then 2*(a:ℤ)*((b:ℤ)-3) else 0

theorem cell_lower (k a t b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    (if a=1 ∧ b=2 then (-2:ℤ) else 0) ≤ cell k a t b := by
  classical
  by_cases hab : a=1 ∧ b=2
  · obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := hab
    simp only [ite_true, and_self, cell]
    by_cases h : ∃ u ∈ Icc 1 k, t+2*u=k
    · obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩ := h
      rw [sum_eq_single u]
      · norm_num [he]
      · intro v hv hvu
        have hn : t+2*v ≠ k := by intro h'; apply hvu; omega
        simp [hn]
      · intro hn; exact (hn hu).elim
    · have hz : ∀ u ∈ Icc 1 k, t+2*u ≠ k := by simpa only [not_exists, not_and] using h
      apply le_trans (show (-2:ℤ) ≤ 0 by omega)
      apply sum_nonneg
      intro u hu
      simp [hz u hu]
  · simp only [hab, ite_false]
    apply sum_nonneg
    intro u hu
    split_ifs with h
    · have hb : 3 ≤ b := by omega
      have hb' : (3:ℤ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
      have ha' : (0:ℤ) ≤ a := by positivity
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by omega) ha') (by omega)
    · rfl

theorem mixed_sum_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    -2*(k:ℤ) ≤ ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k, cell k a t b := by
  classical
  have h : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k,
      if a=1 ∧ b=2 then (-2:ℤ) else 0) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k, cell k a t b := by
    apply sum_le_sum; intro a ha
    apply sum_le_sum; intro t ht
    apply sum_le_sum; intro b hb
    exact cell_lower k a t b (mem_Icc.mp ha).1
  have he : (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k,
      if a=1 ∧ b=2 then (-2:ℤ) else 0) = -2*(k:ℤ) := by
    simp [ite_and, sum_ite_eq', mem_Icc, show 1 ≤ k by omega, show 2 ≤ k by omega]
    ring
  rwa [he] at h

end HaradaKernel
```

```lean
import HaradaKernelBounds
import HaradaKernelSmall
namespace HaradaKernel
open Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coeff_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) : (k:ℤ)^2-9*(k:ℤ) ≤ coeff k := by
  change (k:ℤ)^2-9*(k:ℤ) ≤ (∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, single k a) +
    ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ t ∈ Icc 1 k, ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 k, cell k a t b
  linarith [single_sum_lower k hk, mixed_sum_lower k hk]

theorem coeff_pos (k : ℕ) (hk : 5 ≤ k) : 0 < coeff k := by
  by_cases h : 10 ≤ k
  · have hc : (10:ℤ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast h
    have hl := coeff_lower k (by omega)
    nlinarith
  · have : k=5 ∨ k=6 ∨ k=7 ∨ k=8 ∨ k=9 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

theorem coeff_nonneg (k : ℕ) (hk : 5 ≤ k) : 0 ≤ coeff k := le_of_lt (coeff_pos k hk)
end HaradaKernel
```

```lean
import HaradaKernelSigns
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset

open scoped BigOperators
namespace HaradaKernel
open Finset

def convolution (q : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, coeff k * (q (n-k) : ℤ)

theorem convolution_lower (q : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 7 ≤ n) :
    -2*(q (n-2):ℤ)-4*(q (n-3):ℤ)-4*(q (n-4):ℤ) +
      16*(q (n-6):ℤ)+38*(q (n-7):ℤ) ≤ convolution q n := by
  classical
  have hs : ({2,3,4,6,7} : Finset ℕ) ⊆ Icc 1 n := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hk
    rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp only [mem_Icc] <;> omega
  have h := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hs (f := fun k => coeff k * (q (n-k):ℤ))
    (by
      intro k hk hnot
      have hk1 := (mem_Icc.mp hk).1
      simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton, not_or] at hnot
      by_cases h1 : k=1
      · subst k; simp [coeff_1]
      · exact mul_nonneg (coeff_nonneg k (by omega)) (by positivity))
  simp [coeff_2, coeff_3, coeff_4, coeff_6, coeff_7] at h
  unfold convolution
  linarith

theorem convolution_margin (q : ℕ → ℕ) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hr : ∀ m, 7 ≤ m → 2*q m ≤ 3*q (m-1))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 13 ≤ n) :
    81*(q (n-7):ℤ) ≤ 16*convolution q n := by
  have step (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ 6) :
      2*(q (n-i):ℤ) ≤ 3*(q (n-(i+1)):ℤ) := by
    have h := hr (n-i) (by omega)
    have he : n-i-1 = n-(i+1) := by omega
    rw [he] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have h2 := step 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := step 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := step 4 (by omega)
  have h5 := step 5 (by omega)
  have h6 := step 6 (by omega)
  have hm : (q (n-7):ℤ) ≤ (q (n-6):ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq (show n-7 ≤ n-6 by omega)
  have hl := convolution_lower q n (by omega)
  norm_num only [Nat.reduceAdd] at h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  linarith

theorem convolution_pos (q : ℕ → ℕ) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hp : ∀ m, 0 < q m)
    (hr : ∀ m, 7 ≤ m → 2*q m ≤ 3*q (m-1))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 13 ≤ n) : 0 < convolution q n := by
  have hm := convolution_margin q hq hr n hn
  have hp' : (0:ℤ) < q (n-7) := by exact_mod_cast hp (n-7)
  linarith

end HaradaKernel
```

```lean
import HaradaGenerating
namespace Harada

theorem length_rows {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) :
    (rows q).1.length = q.parts.card := by simp [rows]

theorem column_rows {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (j : ℕ) :
    ((rows q).1.filter (fun a => j ≤ a)).length = column q j := by
  have h := congrArg (fun m : Multiset ℕ => (m.filter (fun a => j ≤ a)).card)
    (Multiset.sort_eq q.parts (· ≥ ·))
  simpa only [rows, column, Multiset.filter_coe, Multiset.coe_card] using h

theorem column_sum_tail {n : ℕ} (q : Nat.Partition n) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+t), column q (j+1) * column q (j+2)) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, column q (j+1) * column q (j+2) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
  apply add_eq_left.mpr
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _hi
  rw [column_missing q (by omega), zero_mul]

def IntegerTarget : Prop := ∀ n : ℤ, 7 ≤ n → 0 < D n.toNat

theorem target_iff_integer : Target ↔ IntegerTarget := by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn
    apply h
    omega
  · intro h n hn
    have hi : (7 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := by omega
    simpa using h (n : ℤ) hi

#print axioms column_rows
#print axioms column_sum_tail
#print axioms target_iff_integer
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaMarked
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem sum_multiples (n a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range n, if (t+1)*a ≤ n then f ((t+1)*a) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, if a ∣ k then f k else 0 := by
  rw [← sum_filter, ← sum_filter]
  apply sum_bij (fun t _ => (t+1)*a)
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨ht, hb⟩ := mem_filter.mp ht
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, hb⟩, ⟨t+1, by nlinarith⟩⟩
  · intro t ht u hu he
    nlinarith
  · intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hk, hd⟩ := mem_filter.mp hk
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hd
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by nlinarith [mem_Icc.mp hk]
    refine ⟨u-1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply mem_filter.mpr
      constructor
      · apply mem_range.mpr
        have : u ≤ n := by nlinarith [(mem_Icc.mp hk).2]
        omega
      · have : u-1+1 = u := by omega
        rw [this]; nlinarith [(mem_Icc.mp hk).2]
    · have : u-1+1 = u := by omega
      rw [this]; nlinarith
  · intro t _; rfl

theorem divisor_filter (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Icc 1 n) :
    (Icc 1 n).filter (fun a => a ∣ k) = k.divisors := by
  ext a
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.mem_divisors]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨ha, han⟩, hd⟩; exact ⟨hd, by have := mem_Icc.mp hk; omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hk0⟩
    have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd (mem_Icc.mp hk).1
    exact ⟨⟨ha, (Nat.le_of_dvd (mem_Icc.mp hk).1 hd).trans (mem_Icc.mp hk).2⟩, hd⟩

theorem euler_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    n * p n = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, (∑ a ∈ k.divisors, a) * p (n-k) := by
  rw [marked_recurrence]
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, a * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, if a ∣ k then p (n-k) else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      rw [sum_multiples n a (mem_Icc.mp ha).1 (fun k => p (n-k))]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 n, if a ∣ k then a * p (n-k) else 0 := by
      simp_rw [mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero]
      exact sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro k hk
      rw [← sum_filter, divisor_filter n k hk, sum_mul]

#print axioms euler_recurrence
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaPartitions
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
namespace Harada

def fiveParts {m : ℕ} (x : Fin 5 → Fin (m+1)) : Multiset ℕ :=
  Multiset.replicate (x 0).val 2 + Multiset.replicate (x 1).val 3 +
  Multiset.replicate (x 2).val 4 + Multiset.replicate (x 3).val 5 +
  Multiset.replicate (x 4).val 6

theorem fiveParts_sum {m : ℕ} (x : Fin 5 → Fin (m+1)) : (fiveParts x).sum ≤ 20*m := by
  have h0 := (x 0).isLt
  have h1 := (x 1).isLt
  have h2 := (x 2).isLt
  have h3 := (x 3).isLt
  have h4 := (x 4).isLt
  simp only [fiveParts, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul]
  omega

def fivePartition {n m : ℕ} (h : 20*m ≤ n) (x : Fin 5 → Fin (m+1)) : Nat.Partition n where
  parts := fiveParts x + Multiset.replicate (n-(fiveParts x).sum) 1
  parts_pos := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [fiveParts, Multiset.mem_add, Multiset.mem_replicate] at ha
    rcases ha with ((((ha | ha) | ha) | ha) | ha) | ha <;> omega
  parts_sum := by
    simp only [Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le ((fiveParts_sum x).trans h)

theorem fivePartition_injective {n m : ℕ} (h : 20*m ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (fivePartition h) := by
  intro x y he
  have hp := congrArg Nat.Partition.parts he
  have hc (a : ℕ) := congrArg (Multiset.count a) hp
  have h2 := hc 2
  have h3 := hc 3
  have h4 := hc 4
  have h5 := hc 5
  have h6 := hc 6
  simp only [fivePartition, fiveParts, Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate] at h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  norm_num at h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

theorem five_lower_bound {n m : ℕ} (h : 20*m ≤ n) : (m+1)^5 ≤ p n := by
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (fivePartition_injective h)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, p] using hc

#print axioms fivePartition_injective
#print axioms five_lower_bound
end Harada

#eval Lean.versionString
```

```lean
import HaradaInjection
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
namespace Harada

theorem five_floor_lower (n : ℕ) : (n/20+1)^5 ≤ p n :=
  five_lower_bound (by omega)

theorem scaled_five_lower (n : ℕ) : (n+1)^5 ≤ 20^5 * p n := by
  have h : n+1 ≤ 20*(n/20+1) := by omega
  have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h 5
  rw [mul_pow] at hp
  exact hp.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (five_floor_lower n))

theorem ratio_tail_dominance (n : ℕ) (hn : 175 ≤ n) : 5*n^2 < 3*p (n-1) := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hp : n^5 ≤ 20^5 * p (n-1) := by
    have h := scaled_five_lower (n-1)
    have he : n-1+1 = n := by omega
    rwa [he] at h
  have hc := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn 3
  have ht : 5*20^5 < 3*n^3 := by nlinarith only [hc]
  have hm : (5*20^5)*n^2 < (3*n^3)*n^2 := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (Nat.pow_pos hn0)
  nlinarith only [hp, hm]

#print axioms five_floor_lower
#print axioms scaled_five_lower
#print axioms ratio_tail_dominance
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaEuler
import HaradaLower
namespace Harada
open Finset

def sigma (k : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ a ∈ k.divisors, a

theorem sigma_le_square (k : ℕ) : sigma k ≤ k^2 := by
  have hsub : k.divisors ⊆ range (k+1) := by
    intro a ha
    exact mem_range.mpr (by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_mem_divisors ha)) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors ha); omega)
  have hb : ∑ a ∈ k.divisors, a ≤ ∑ _a ∈ k.divisors, k := by
    apply sum_le_sum; intro a ha
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_mem_divisors ha)) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors ha)
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k; simp [sigma]
  · have hc : k.divisors.card ≤ k := by
      have hs : k.divisors ⊆ Icc 1 k := by
        intro a ha
        exact mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors ha, Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors ha)⟩
      have := card_le_card hs
      simpa using this
    simp only [sum_const, smul_eq_mul] at hb
    exact hb.trans (by nlinarith)

theorem euler_sigma (n : ℕ) : n*p n = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, sigma k*p (n-k) :=
  euler_recurrence n

#print axioms sigma_le_square
#print axioms euler_sigma

theorem euler_rat (n : ℕ) : (n : ℚ)*(p n : ℚ) =
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, (sigma k : ℚ)*(p (n-k) : ℚ) := by
  exact_mod_cast euler_sigma n

theorem sigma_rat_le_square (k : ℕ) : (sigma k : ℚ) ≤ (k : ℚ)^2 := by
  exact_mod_cast sigma_le_square k

theorem ratio_tail_rat (n : ℕ) (hn : 175 ≤ n) :
    (5 : ℚ)*n^2 < 3*(p (n-1) : ℚ) := by
  exact_mod_cast ratio_tail_dominance n hn

#print axioms euler_rat
#print axioms sigma_rat_le_square
#print axioms ratio_tail_rat
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaSigma
import HaradaDP
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Intervals
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem reverse_Icc (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n-1), f k = ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1), f (n-j) := by
  apply sum_bij (fun k _ => n-k)
  · intro k hk; simp only [mem_Icc] at *; omega
  · intro a ha b hb hab; simp only [mem_Icc] at *; omega
  · intro j hj; refine ⟨n-j, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [mem_Icc] at * <;> omega
  · intro k hk; congr 1; simp only [mem_Icc] at hk; omega

theorem euler_adjacent (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℚ)*(p n : ℚ) - (3/2 : ℚ)*(n-1 : ℕ)*(p (n-1) : ℚ) =
    (sigma n : ℚ) + ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1),
      (sigma (n-j) : ℚ)*((p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ)) := by
  have hs : Icc 1 n = insert n (Icc 1 (n-1)) := by
    ext k; simp only [mem_Icc, mem_insert]; omega
  have hnot : n ∉ Icc 1 (n-1) := by simp only [mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [mul_assoc (3/2 : ℚ), euler_rat n, euler_rat (n-1), hs, sum_insert hnot]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, p_zero, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
  rw [mul_sum, add_sub_assoc, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  have he : (∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n-1),
      ((sigma k : ℚ)*(p (n-k) : ℚ) - (3/2 : ℚ)*((sigma k : ℚ)*(p (n-1-k) : ℚ)))) =
      ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1), (sigma (n-j) : ℚ)*((p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ)) := by
    rw [reverse_Icc n]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_Icc.mp hj
    have h1 : n-(n-j)=j := by omega
    have h2 : n-1-(n-j)=j-1 := by omega
    rw [h1,h2]; ring
  linarith [he]

theorem small_brackets (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Icc 1 6) :
    (p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ) =
      if j=2 ∨ j=4 ∨ j=6 then 1/2 else if j=3 then 0 else -1/2 := by
  have h2 : p 2 = 2 := by rw [p_eq_dp]; norm_num [dp]
  have h3 : p 3 = 3 := by rw [p_eq_dp]; norm_num [dp]
  have h4 : p 4 = 5 := by rw [p_eq_dp]; norm_num [dp]
  have h5 : p 5 = 7 := by rw [p_eq_dp]; norm_num [dp]
  have h6 : p 6 = 11 := by rw [p_eq_dp]; norm_num [dp]
  rcases mem_Icc.mp hj with ⟨hl,hu⟩
  interval_cases j <;> norm_num [h2,h3,h4,h5,h6]

#print axioms euler_adjacent
#print axioms small_brackets
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaDP
namespace Harada.AbstractCertificate
structure Laws (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop where
  hz : ∀ k, f 0 k = 1
  hn : ∀ n, 0 < n → f n 0 = 0
  hr : ∀ n k, 0 < k → k ≤ n → f n k = f (n-k) k + f n (k-1)
  hc : ∀ n k, n ≤ k → f n k = f n n
end Harada.AbstractCertificate
namespace Harada.AbstractCertificate
variable (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
variable (e : Laws f)
include e
theorem c_1_0 : f 1 0 = 0 := e.hn 1 (by decide)
theorem c_1_1 : f 1 1 = 1 :=
  (e.hr 1 1 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add ((e.hc 0 1 (by decide)).trans (e.hz 0)) (c_1_0 f e))
theorem c_2_0 : f 2 0 = 0 := e.hn 2 (by decide)
theorem c_2_1 : f 2 1 = 1 :=
  (e.hr 2 1 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_1_1 f e) (c_2_0 f e))
theorem c_2_2 : f 2 2 = 2 :=
  (e.hr 2 2 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (e.hz 2) (c_2_1 f e))
theorem c_3_0 : f 3 0 = 0 := e.hn 3 (by decide)
theorem c_3_1 : f 3 1 = 1 :=
  (e.hr 3 1 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_2_1 f e) (c_3_0 f e))
theorem c_3_2 : f 3 2 = 2 :=
  (e.hr 3 2 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add ((e.hc 1 2 (by decide)).trans (c_1_1 f e)) (c_3_1 f e))
theorem c_3_3 : f 3 3 = 3 :=
  (e.hr 3 3 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (e.hz 3) (c_3_2 f e))
theorem c_4_0 : f 4 0 = 0 := e.hn 4 (by decide)
theorem c_4_1 : f 4 1 = 1 :=
  (e.hr 4 1 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_3_1 f e) (c_4_0 f e))
theorem c_4_2 : f 4 2 = 3 :=
  (e.hr 4 2 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_2_2 f e) (c_4_1 f e))
theorem c_4_3 : f 4 3 = 4 :=
  (e.hr 4 3 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add ((e.hc 1 3 (by decide)).trans (c_1_1 f e)) (c_4_2 f e))
theorem c_4_4 : f 4 4 = 5 :=
  (e.hr 4 4 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (e.hz 4) (c_4_3 f e))
theorem c_5_0 : f 5 0 = 0 := e.hn 5 (by decide)
theorem c_5_1 : f 5 1 = 1 :=
  (e.hr 5 1 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_4_1 f e) (c_5_0 f e))
theorem c_5_2 : f 5 2 = 3 :=
  (e.hr 5 2 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (c_3_2 f e) (c_5_1 f e))
theorem c_5_3 : f 5 3 = 5 :=
  (e.hr 5 3 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add ((e.hc 2 3 (by decide)).trans (c_2_2 f e)) (c_5_2 f e))
theorem c_5_4 : f 5 4 = 6 :=
  (e.hr 5 4 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add ((e.hc 1 4 (by decide)).trans (c_1_1 f e)) (c_5_3 f e))
theorem c_5_5 : f 5 5 = 7 :=
  (e.hr 5 5 (by decide) (by decide)).trans (congrArg₂ Nat.add (e.hz 5) (c_5_4 f e))
theorem c_6_0 : f 6 0 = 0 := e.hn 6 (by decide)
theorem c_6_1 : f 6 1 = 1 :=
```

```lean
theorem bounded_cap (n k : ℕ) (h : n ≤ k) : b n k = b n n := (b_eq_p h).trans (b_eq_p (le_refl n)).symm
```

```lean
import HaradaAdjacent
import HaradaFiniteV2
namespace Harada
open Finset

theorem adjacent_sum_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 175 ≤ n)
    (ih : ∀ j, 7 ≤ j → j < n → 2*p j ≤ 3*p (j-1)) :
    (sigma n : ℚ) + ∑ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1),
      (sigma (n-j) : ℚ)*((p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ)) ≤ (5/2 : ℚ)*(n : ℚ)^2 := by
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1),
      (sigma (n-j) : ℚ)*((p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ))) ≤
      (3/2 : ℚ)*(n : ℚ)^2 := by
    have hb : ∀ j ∈ Icc 1 (n-1),
        (sigma (n-j) : ℚ)*((p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ)) ≤
        (if j=2 then (n : ℚ)^2/2 else 0) +
        (if j=4 then (n : ℚ)^2/2 else 0) +
        (if j=6 then (n : ℚ)^2/2 else 0) := by
      intro j hj
      rcases mem_Icc.mp hj with ⟨hl,hu⟩
      have hz : (0 : ℚ) ≤ sigma (n-j) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hs : (sigma (n-j) : ℚ) ≤ (n : ℚ)^2 := by
        have hsub : (n-j : ℕ) ≤ n := Nat.sub_le _ _
        have hc : ((n-j : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hsub
        have hc0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (n-j : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        have h := sigma_rat_le_square (n-j)
        nlinarith
      by_cases hj6 : j ≤ 6
      · have hb := small_brackets j (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hl,hj6⟩)
        interval_cases j <;> norm_num at hb ⊢ <;> rw [hb] <;> nlinarith
      · have hr : (2 : ℚ)*(p j : ℚ) ≤ 3*(p (j-1) : ℚ) := by
          exact_mod_cast ih j (by omega) (by omega)
        have hc : (p j : ℚ)-(3/2 : ℚ)*(p (j-1) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hm := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hz hc
        have h2 : j ≠ 2 := by omega
        have h4 : j ≠ 4 := by omega
        have h6 : j ≠ 6 := by omega
        simpa [h2,h4,h6] using hm
    have h := sum_le_sum hb
    have h2 : 2 ∈ Icc 1 (n-1) := mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega,by omega⟩
    have h4 : 4 ∈ Icc 1 (n-1) := mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega,by omega⟩
    have h6 : 6 ∈ Icc 1 (n-1) := mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega,by omega⟩
    simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_ite_eq', ite_eq_left h2, ite_eq_left h4, ite_eq_left h6] at h
    linarith
  linarith [sigma_rat_le_square n]

theorem uniform_ratio (n : ℕ) (hn : 7 ≤ n) : 2*p n ≤ 3*p (n-1) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hsmall : n ≤ 174
    · exact finite_ratio n hn hsmall
    · have hlarge : 175 ≤ n := by omega
      have hbound := adjacent_sum_bound n hlarge (fun j hj hjn => ih j hjn hj)
      have he := euler_adjacent n (by omega)
      have ht := ratio_tail_rat n hlarge
      have hcast : ((n-1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (n : ℚ)-1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]; norm_num
      rw [hcast] at he
      have hnq : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<n by omega)
      have hc : (2 : ℚ)*(p n : ℚ) ≤ 3*(p (n-1) : ℚ) := by
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hc

#print axioms adjacent_sum_bound
#print axioms uniform_ratio
end Harada
```

```lean
import HaradaFiniteDBases
import HaradaConvolution
import HaradaSourceBridge
import HaradaRatio

namespace Harada

theorem source_D_pos_large (n : ℕ) (hn : 13 ≤ n) : 0 < D n := by
  have hc := HaradaKernel.convolution_pos p p_mono p_pos uniform_ratio n hn
  have he := source_D_convolution n
  change 0 < ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, HaradaKernel.coeff k * (p (n-k) : ℤ) at hc
  omega

theorem target_proved : Target := by
  intro n hn
  by_cases hl : 13 ≤ n
  · exact source_D_pos_large n hl
  · exact source_D_pos_7_12 n hn (by omega)

theorem integerTarget_proved : IntegerTarget :=
  target_iff_integer.mp target_proved
```
